title: A heap of particles
text: Up to a million particles pushed apart on the GPU, and pushed away by the pointer.

title: A box that tilts
text: The same particles with friction, in a box that tilts by up to 30 degrees.

title: Different sizes
text: Particles of different sizes, the largest up to four times the smallest.

title: Ropes
text: Ropes of particles joined by springs: they hang, swing and are pushed by the pointer.

title: A cloth
text: A cloth of particles joined by springs, hanging by its top edge.

title: Curtains
text: Tall, narrow cloths hanging side by side. Grab one and pull it.

title: A pile of cloths
text: Square cloths dropped in a heap. Drag one out from under the others.

title: Cloths with no gravity
text: Three cloths waving in slow currents, with no gravity. Grab one and pull.

title: A net full of particles
text: A cloth held by its four corners catches loose particles: push it from below with a ball.

title: Curtains and a heap
text: Curtains hang over a heap of loose particles: a ball pushes both, and throws the particles at the curtains.

title: Shadows
text: A small pile and the ways we draw it, with soft shadows and colors.

title: Side by side
text: Every way of pushing particles apart we studied, running together.

title: A fountain
text: Particles under gravity, in the debug viewer.
